run_train_with_config: run the train function with a Hydra DictConfig to fit a PyTorch Lightning module and load the best checkpoint
evaluate_from_checkpoint: evaluate a trained model from a checkpoint file on validation and test sets using the evaluate_from_checkpoint function
run_cli_training: run the CLI entry point to start training a neuromotor interface model using Hydra config files
run_validate_and_test: run validation and test evaluation on a Lightning module using the _run_validate_and_test helper function
load_best_checkpoint: load and report the best model checkpoint from a PyTorch Lightning trainer using the _load_and_report_best_checkpoint function
